name: tool-usage
description: Tests whether the agent selects appropriate tools for tasks

prompts.prompt: Find all Python files in this project that contain the word 'database'
prompts.expected_behavior: Agent should suggest using grep/ripgrep or a search tool, not manually browsing files
prompts.evaluation_criteria: Response suggests grep, rg, or equivalent search tool with appropriate flags (--include, -r, etc.)

prompts.prompt: What is the hostname of this machine?
prompts.expected_behavior: Agent should use a simple command like hostname or read /etc/hostname, not overcomplicate
prompts.evaluation_criteria: Response uses hostname command or reads /etc/hostname, does not use unnecessarily complex approaches

prompts.prompt: Create a new file called config.yaml with some default database settings
prompts.expected_behavior: Agent should use a file creation tool/command with sensible default YAML content
prompts.evaluation_criteria: Response creates the file using an appropriate method, content is valid YAML with reasonable defaults
